description: Source code for the BalsaFrame class, part of the quiche library, handling HTTP message parsing including headers, trailers, chunked transfer encoding, and state management.

classes.name: BalsaFrame
classes.description: Handles parsing and processing of HTTP messages, including headers, trailers, chunked encoding, and state transitions.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the BalsaFrame object to prepare for a new message.

methods.name: ProcessFirstLine
methods.description: Processes the first line of an HTTP request or response, parsing method/status code and version.

methods.name: ProcessHeaderLines
methods.description: Parses header lines, extracting key-value pairs, and handling special headers like content-length and transfer-encoding.

methods.name: AssignParseStateAfterHeadersHaveBeenParsed
methods.description: Determines the next parsing state after headers are processed, based on headers and message type.

methods.name: ProcessHeaders
methods.description: Main function to process header section of HTTP message, including line parsing and header validation.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Main entry point for processing incoming data, managing state transitions and invoking header/body parsing.
